label: Empty Check
description: Checks whether a connected PHP value or configured variable path is empty.

properties.name: variable_path
properties.label: Variable path fallback
properties.help: Used only when Value is not connected. Use a PHP variable name without the dollar sign. Dot notation addresses nested values, for example form.email.

properties.name: access_mode
properties.label: Nested access
properties.help: Used by the variable path fallback. Array generates ['key'] access. Object generates ->property access.
